Description
The Perth Mint’s gold bars are highlighted for their extraordinary purity, with a fineness of 99.99%, exceeding the usual 22-karat (91.67% pure) gold commonly used in coins. So, Investing in gold, such as 1 oz Gold Bar Perth Mint (In Assay), can help diversify a portfolio and protect against potential risks such as inflation, currency depreciation, and geopolitical events.
Compared to 22 karat gold bars with 91.67%, Perth mint 1 oz gold bars are made of 99.99% pure gold. In contrast, the higher the purity of gold, the higher the quality, which means buying mint products would be a wiser decision for every buyer, investor, and collector.
The Perth Mint, founded in 1899 as a part of the Royal Mint of Britain, has earned a reputation among investors and collectors worldwide for manufacturing high-quality
gold coins and bars
. It was originally formed to mint sovereigns from Western Australian gold, but the Western Australian State Government later acquired it in 1970.
Design of 1 oz Gold Bar – Perth Mint (In Assay)
The design of the Perth mint gold bar symbolizes peace of mind. The certified security features ensure that the product you receive is in the same condition described in this product listing.
This product’s observation side features the Emblem of the Perth Mint Australia of a majestic swan encircled by engraving. And the lower part weight and purity of gold can be seen. While in the reverse side, the product is designed diagonally with the repetition of jumping kangaroos contrasting with the frosted finish of the bar itself.
Highlights of 1 oz Gold Bar Perth Mint (In Assay)
This Product Contains 1 oz of .9999 pure gold.
Each Product is provided in sealed plastic with an Assay Card.
Each Product has a unique serial number.
Eligible for use in Precious Metal IRA accounts.
On the observer side, the majestic Swan appears on the face of each bar, making it a distinctive symbol of Australia’s heritage.
On the reverse side, the Product is graced with wallpapered figures of kangaroos jumping.
